declaredBefore: any toolkit tuning on evaluation results and any holdout trial

sets.REL: holdout tasks with relation=related (4 tasks x repeats)
sets.DEC: holdout tasks with relation=decoy (2 tasks x repeats)

definitions.success: visible tests pass AND every hidden AC check passes AND every hidden REG check passes
definitions.orgPassRate: passed [org:*] checks / all [org:*] checks, over the set
definitions.discoverablePassRate: passed AC checks without an [org:*] tag / all such AC checks, over the set
definitions.regressions: number of trials with at least one failing REG check
definitions.repeatedMistakes: number of holdout trials that fail a check tagged [org:x] or [trap:x] where the same condition received QA feedback naming a failed check with that tag during training
definitions.interventions: trials that ended asking the user, escalated to the user, ran out of budget/turns, or timed out
definitions.costUsd: total_cost_usd reported by the Claude Code CLI for the session (subagents included)
definitions.costPerSuccess: sum of costUsd over the set / number of successful trials in the set

mandatory.what: Learning raises org-rule compliance on unfamiliar tasks

mandatory.rule: C2 <= 0.5 * C1 AND C1 >= 3 (fewer than 3 C1 repeated mistakes = not informative = not met)

mandatory.what: Learning raises task success on related unfamiliar tasks
Learning does no harm when a lesson must be rejected
Enhanced ECC with learning beats original ECC
No more regressions than original ECC
No more human intervention than original ECC
Cost per successful task is bounded

claims.what: Orchestration alone adds value on discoverable requirements (claimed only if met)
Orchestration alone does not add regressions

claims.metric: mean costUsd and mean wall time

reporting: per task x condition: successes out of repeats (pass^k consistency), AC and org pass rates, cost, wall time
95% Wilson intervals for rates; small samples are stated as such
every failed target and every unsuccessful case is listed with its cause
